decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 8.3	The proposed trees within the landscaping scheme are considered to be acceptable and compliment the existing vegetation. This is in accordance within Policy ENV.B.1.1. of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan

8.4	INFORMATIVES
The proposed lavender does not compliment the existing vegetation and should be substituted with a species more commonly found within damp woodland such as a mixture of Cornus Alba and Cornus Stolonifera Cultivars.

Imported topsoil should not contain pernicious weeds capable of invading the Grand Union Canals green corridor.
description: Following approval for erection of three storey extension to existing storage warehouse details submitted pursuant to Condition 4 (landscaping) of approved planning permission 01130/D/P10 dated 08/02/2005
